# Vendored rpe-next expression engine

Source: https://github.com/kclg-YSJ/rpe-next/tree/274bc55866dc5893e68c95bb4107f79711f1aa1d

Copied `src/core/batch-script.mjs` and `src/core/easing.mjs` on 2026-10-27.
`batch-script.mjs` replaces the editor translation import with standalone error
messages. The numeric expression grammar and easing formulas are retained.

These files retain their **PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0**, including the
required notices in NOTICE. They are not relicensed under the repository's root
license. No competitor editor assets, charts, models, or credentials are included.
The native PhiChain integration and other adapter files are separate code.
